g.text: B Incumbent deactivation → original-core deficit and recovery
Instantaneous 0.5% tapered basal-excess direction moves active into inactive; no countercue; paired sham.
B shading marks the previously qualified early estimator window (≤20% restoration); later lines are valid finite-time responses.
Native doses and clocks have no shared optical or reporter calibration. These are conditional readout options, not a replacement Figure 2 layout.
